about_item: Dual Functionality: Equipped with a powerful dryer and a built-in heater, this grooming tool allows you to customize the grooming experience based on your pet's needs. Use the dryer for quick drying and the heater for added comfort during colder seasons.

Variable Speed and Temperature Control: With adjustable speed and temperature settings, this grooming dryer provides complete control over the drying process. Whether your pet has a thick coat or requires a gentle touch, you can tailor the settings for optimal results without causing stress.

Low Noise Operation: Designed with your pet's comfort in mind, our grooming dryer operates quietly and with minimal vibration. This ensures a stress-free grooming experience, making it ideal for sensitive or nervous pets.

Durable and Portable Design: Built to withstand the demands of both home and commercial use, this grooming dryer features a durable construction that stands the test of time. The portable design makes it easy to take with you wherever grooming is needed, providing convenience without sacrificing power.

Equipped and Info: come with 10 ft flexible hose, 1x flat nozzle, 1x round nozzle, 1x extra filter, 1 year warranty. Heat Levels: None, Low, High Temperature: 81F to 160F. Power: 12.72 amps/Voltage 110V/60 Cycle

authors_reviews.title: Great Dryer For Grooming Our Standard Poodle.
authors_reviews.text: Does a really good job of drying our Standard Poodle. This blower is quiet, has two heat settings and plenty of force. Flying pig even sells replacement brushes for the motor. When you get enough use out of a motor that you need to (and can) re-brush it, that tells you it's a quality product.
authors_reviews.author: Scott

authors_reviews.title: Wonderful compact high velocity pet dryer
authors_reviews.text: First impression of this high velocity pet dryer: perfection. This is hands down the lightest weight and most of the most compact design, not to mention quietest high velocity pet dryer I’ve ever used. Is it the most powerful - I would say no, it’s not but I don’t really want to be pelted with fast moving water spray either so this is still pretty perfect.My pup really hates being dried because of the noise but she stood mostly still for this dryer, even around her ears and face. She has a fairly dense double coat and this dryer powered through separating her hair down to the skin no problem. It loosened shedding hair with ease and air temp stayed consistent. There was a faint warm rubber smell for the first few minutes of use but it dissipated quickly. I ended up drying her in the tub in our fairly small guest bathroom. The drying process was fast and she ended up very soft and fluffy in about 10 minutes on the II setting, air was just above the room temp in warmth. The hose itself did get a little hot to the touch but nothing unbearable on my hands/arms, just moved it away if it was uncomfortable. This dryer will make finishing baths so speedy.
authors_reviews.author: K. Watabu

authors_reviews.title: GREAT BUY. No regrets, VERY happy.
authors_reviews.text: Amazing, works as expected. HIGH powered. Needed to start on lowest setting and work my way up with her (grooming 7 mo. Old GSD pup 1st time exp. W/ blower). I chose to groom her at home to ease stress on her and it’s great bonding time and I enjoy it. The drying time was probably cut in more than half. Love the attachments. Make SURE YOU REMOVE AND CLEAN THAT FILTER every time. Mine was FULL after one use. Can’t say enough about this. My breeder also recommended it after I purchased it already as she uses it for all of her dogs. I researched every brand out there and landed on this one because of the reviews and value for price. I’m hoping it lives up to expectations longevity wise. I’ve heard great things about their customer service.
authors_reviews.author: Lindsay G.

authors_reviews.title: Love it!!
authors_reviews.text: Personally flying pig is my favorite! I have 2 bathtubs from them and two hand dryers, I’ve had them for years they are great quality they make all there products easy to use and maintenance/clean! Noise level is great due to the ability to change the speeds but it can get honestly pretty quiet and you can turn the heat on and off which I love.
authors_reviews.author: Marlee Thurman

authors_reviews.title: Get this
authors_reviews.text: This dryer is wonderful! Not too loud but not quiet, the power on this is great! It blows warm and cool air that you can adjust for the comfort of your fur baby. I have 3 different types of dogs, long hair German shepherd, mini American Eskimo, and a border Collie Cattle dog mix with long silky hair. This works great on all three! I would recommend this to anyone. I got this on sale but even at full price it’s worth every penny! It’s not too heavy & it is easy to use. It’s made life easier for us and allows us to groom at home where our dogs are most comfortable.
authors_reviews.author: H. Longley

authors_reviews.title: Great dryer. Just FYI...
authors_reviews.text: I flibbin love this thing! I'm a pro groomer and have bought all the dryers except the really expensive ones as they just blow too hard. I have a few criticisms but that doesn't affect the rating.1. The hose is too fat and short. If you pull on it to stretch it out, the dryer just drags along. I have it mounted but I still have to pull pretty firmly to get it to stretch on low speed. When I take the concentrator off to get a more gentle air flow for the face, the opening is just too big to get a good aim on the face. I'd love a hose more like metro has on their dryers.2. The knob that controls the air power is something that seems like a weak point. Concerned about that malfunctioning and leaving me stuck on high.3. There is a very loud high pitched noise that comes out of the dryer if you increase the air volume at all. At the lowest setting, it is extremely quiet.Those may not sound minor but as I use it several times a day, I still give it 5 stars. I'd buy another one immediately if those things change
authors_reviews.author: M C BOWERS

authors_reviews.title: Wonderful purchase.
authors_reviews.text: This has saved us so much money in only a few months. We wash our Golden Retriever every month or less and by being able to blow dry him in the winter we can now groom him at home. We also use this for a quick blow out when his coat gets to smelling a little too much like a dog. Just a few minutes and he smells fresh again. We really love it and hope it lasts a great long time.
authors_reviews.author: Teresa

authors_reviews.title: Over tat
authors_reviews.text: Not super thrilled with the velocity and the amount of hair being removed. We used it after a bath when the dog was wet as well as after brushing and on its own and when not used with bathing or brushing its next useless. For nearly 200 bucks I wouldn't waste my money again. We have 2 labs and it's spring time and shedding season, we still have to put just as much effort into brushing as before so no real point to even owning this. I would suggest going with a cheaper one or reversing a shop vac to be used as a blower. The only nice feature here is the heat for cold weather, I think the dogs will like it. Other than that go another route.
authors_reviews.author: Dan

other_countries_reviews.title: Air leaking from cord, buttons and hose after a few months of use
other_countries_reviews.text: I previously owned this model of dryer for 6 years with no issue. I’m a professional groomer and use it daily so eventually the motor started to fail. I replaced it with this dryer & although it works well, it has air leaking from the connection cord, one of the buttons and from two different areas on the hose after 3 months of use. I wouldn’t expect that for the price & quality of my previous model. Quite disappointed
other_countries_reviews.author: KMSH
